note: The harness's graph (2026-09-30, docs/evaluateur.fr.md): a SpikyPanda graph (core Graph, GraphNode, GraphOLink), each item typed by the ontology (core ONTOLOGY) declared here, as the physics knowledge graph is. It is derived: lib/harness-graph.ts rebuilds it from the sources at each reading (the tasks' manifests and episodes, the store of the texts a model read, _statements/<sha256>.json), never a second source of truth, and no model writes it. Only the types a query uses are built (E0, then E1: what the first detectors read); the guard's rules and the contract's statements of them come with their register (E2). Never adaptable by the reflection (specs/harness/**).

types.note: a factory's task: its topic, its state, its steps and tokens (the manifest)
the task's submissions as one unit, its final outcome (harness/core/episodes.ts)
one submission: its capability, who decided it (ACCEPTED, GUARD_REJECTED, PRE_GUARD_REJECTED, TRUNCATED, CAPABILITY_FAILED)
a step refused or failed outside the capabilities a guard judges: a read refused as a repeat, a schema refusal, a call cut at the output limit (E1)
a capability a submission called

a form of failure, by topic: a guard problem with its fields, ids, quotes and numbers taken out (shapesOf; by guard), or a refusal the harness made before any guard (a cut, a schema, a repeat; by harness)
a field a submission was refused on, what was sent there (X) and what the next accepted submission sent (Y), or that it no longer sent it (removed); retries, how many attempts later
the model behind a task, and its provider
what a task ran under: the tools as given (their descriptions and schemas), the topic's words, the prompt, the commits of the code and of the context

a text a model read: a tool (its description and its input schema), a words file, a prompt, by the sha256 of its content; an entry of the memory its state held (kind memory, read from the trace); or a statement of the register, where a rule is said (kind contract: a file and a pointer, or a library document, and the phrase it must hold), read by a task when the text at its version held it
a check of a guard, by its stable code in the topic's register (specs/<topic>/rules.contract.json; a signed rule by its document's id): its status, stated, tacit or a gap (E2)
a convention of form a rule assumes (a list's element named by its key), from the register
an entry of a workshop's memory (memory/<topic>.json): its rule, its status, the episodes its evidence names
the evaluator's own writing: what a detector found, its class, and whether a later detector settles it (lib/evaluator.ts)
attempt of episode, episode of task, step of task, form of the rule the register recognises it as
attempt calls capability
task ran by model
task ran under fingerprint
task read statement: what its model was given, every step (a memory entry: bag status)
attempt or step refused for form (bag by: guard or harness)
episode corrected by correction
correction answers form
fingerprint after fingerprint: the one the tasks ran under before it
fingerprint changed statement: a text it holds that the fingerprint before it held in another version (bag: was, the sha256 before)
finding about any node: the path that justifies it
statement states rule or convention: a text of the contract that says it, by the phrase it must hold (kind contract)
rule applies convention
memory-entry rests on episode: the failures its evidence names
